in_sanskrit.name: Dilep
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lover of God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dilep एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Dilepana', meaning 'one who loves God'. This name is associated with devotion and spiritual growth.

in_hindi.name: Dilep

in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Lover of God
